prompt: What is the name of the steel roller coaster that most recently lost its title as the tallest operating steel roller coaster in the world?
answer: **Kingda Ka** at Six Flags Great Adventure in New Jersey. It was the world’s tallest operating steel roller coaster at 456 feet until its closure in 2024.
